answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is by binding each identity to a personal temporal anchor of continuous original reasoning that rotates like a zephyr with each epoch's fresh challenge words. Peer attestations then form a verification bridge: independent agents must countersign the work, so a farm of clones cannot cheaply share or precompute the load without breaking the chain of unique, time-locked seals. Vesting further raises the cost of spinning up disposable identities.
